SELECT BUYER , STATUS AS GUBUN , PLANT AS BUKRS , ADD_DATE AS ORDDT , DOC_NO AS PX_NO , DOC_SEQ AS PX_SEQ , PR_NO AS ORD01 , PR_SEQ AS ORD02 , BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEMC , DESCRIPTION AS ZITEMCT , SPECIFICATION AS ZSPEC , 'KRW' AS WAERS , ROUND(ITEM_QTY) AS POQTY , ROUND(UNIT_PRICE) AS PRICE , ROUND(ITEM_AMT) AS SALAMT , LEGACY_USER_ID AS ORDNM , REQ_USER_NAME AS ORDNMN , NULL AS TAKNM , RECVER_NAME AS TAKNMN , KEY_1 AS LIFNR , KEY_2 AS LIFNRT , KEY_3 AS DEPT2 , BUDGET_DEPT AS KOSTL , HI_DEPT_CODE AS FISTL , ACCOUNT_TYPE AS HKONT , USER_ID AS LOGID FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND company_code = 'KRAMORG001' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
